svg.text: Never the fix: setenforce 0 or SELINUX=disabled

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Permissive mode is a ten-minute test that proves SELinux is the cause. Switch back to enforcing and apply A, B, C or D.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Disabling it removes the containment that stops a compromised service reaching everything else.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Find denials: ausearch -m AVC,USER_AVC -ts recent; explain them: sealert -a /var/log/audit/audit.log. Controls supported: AC-3, AC-6, CM-6.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Red Hat artwork.
